products.title: Medium Big Green Egg in a Modular Nest Package
products.body_html:
Package Includes:

products.title: 4 in Locking Caster Kit - Set of 2 (4 total)
products.body_html:

Each kit (set of 2) includes 1 locking and 1 non-locking caster; the casters work with the Big Green Egg Modular Nest System, the IntEGGrated Nest+Handler and all Big Green Egg Nests (aside from the MiniMax Portable) and Tables.
  • Heavy-duty for better wear through high-use conditions
  • 2-way brake locks both roll and rotation
  • Solid polyurethane wheel

products.title: Caster Kit - (4 in/10 cm) 1 locking 1 non-locking for Modular Nests, Nests and Wood Tables
products.body_html: Caster Kit is a matte black set with 2 swivel wheels, 1 of which has a brake, specially designed for Big Green Egg. The wheels fit on EGG Nest, Modular System, and acacia table. With the sturdy and smooth swivel wheels, you can easily move the EGG in all directions. Includes a wrench for easy assembly and disassembly of the wheels. Rotate, roll, ready. Does not work with the MiniMax nest.

products.title: Acacia Insert for Modular Nest System
products.body_html: Made of solid acacia wood. Designed for outdoor use with slats and galvanized screws. Having trouble deciding? You can always change it later.

products.title: Expansion Cabinet for Modular Nest System
products.body_html:
The Big Green Egg Modular Nest System offers a customizable outdoor cooking solution. This versatile system adapts to your cooking needs, starting with the foundational EGG Frame and expanding with additional frames or the new watertight Expansion Cabinet. Customize your setup with a range of inserts, each designed to enhance your cooking workflow and storage options. The system's powder-coated aluminum construction ensures durability in outdoor environments.

The Expansion Cabinet offers:

  • Watertight storage for charcoal and accessories
  • Dimensions: 30 in L x 30 in W x 30.5 in H
  • Weight: 63 lbs.
  • Includes one Connector Pack for seamless integration
  • 4 adjustable levelers (compatible with optional 2" (5 cm) and 4" (10 cm) casters)

Pair with your favorite cabinet top (not included) to customize your ideal setup.

This modular approach allows you to build your ideal outdoor kitchen incrementally, adapting to your space and cooking style. Each component of the Nest System is engineered to work in harmony, creating a cohesive and efficient cooking environment that grows with your culinary ambitions.

products.title: Expansion Frame for Modular Nest System
products.body_html:
The Big Green Egg Modular Nest System offers a flexible and customizable outdoor cooking solution. This innovative system adapts to your evolving culinary needs, offering unparalleled flexibility in creating your ideal outdoor kitchen. Begin with the EGG Frame, then expand your setup with additional frames and a range of functional inserts. The standardized design ensures seamless integration, allowing you to customize your cooking area with precision and style.

Key features:

  • Expandable design: Start small, grow as needed
  • Rust-resistant aluminum top frame and legs
  • Steel lower shelf frame for stability
  • Adjustable levelers (4 included)
  • Compatible with optional 2" (5 cm) and 4" (10 cm) casters
  • Interchangeable inserts fit both top and lower shelf frames

The Modular Nest System transforms your outdoor space into a chef's paradise, combining form and function in a way that only Big Green Egg can deliver. Whether you're grilling, smoking, or baking, this system provides the foundation for extraordinary culinary experiences. As your skills grow, so too can your outdoor kitchen—all with the quality and innovation you've come to expect from Big Green Egg.

products.title: Modular EGG Mate
products.body_html:
The Modular Nest Mate is a versatile side shelf that expands your outdoor cooking workspace. This versatile side shelf seamlessly integrates with Modular Nests, offering a sleek, screw-free top surface that complements your egg's aesthetic. When not in use, it folds vertically, preserving valuable patio space without compromising on functionality. The Nest Mate supports up to 40 lbs (18.1 kg), providing ample room for prep work, plating, or displaying your culinary creations.

  • Dimensions: 16" x 25" (40.6 cm x 63.5 cm)
  • Material: Solid acacia wood
  • Weight capacity: 40 lbs (18.1 kg)
  • Compatible with: Modular Nests only

products.body_html:
The tool hook is a precision-engineered accessory for your egg grill. Constructed from durable powder-coated aluminum, it securely holds your essential grilling implements within easy reach. The hook attaches effortlessly to the Modular Nest System or Acacia Tables, creating a streamlined workspace that enhances your cooking workflow. Its sleek design complements the egg's iconic silhouette while providing practical functionality for the discerning outdoor chef.
